## Checklist

- [ ] One change per pull request
- [ ] README and `Customize.lua` comments updated if behaviour or settings changed
- [ ] New settings default to the current behaviour
- [ ] If `resources/src` changed: `npm run build` ran and `resources/build` is in the diff
- [ ] No `shots/`, `node_modules/` or version bump in the diff
